description: Schedule a post for a future time. Creator-scoped API keys may use this. Optionally arm engagement boost so authentic first-hour engagement fires automatically when the post goes live.

boost.description: Optional per-post engagement boost. Requires posts:boost and approved=true after the user reviews the exact plan.

approved.description: Must be true only after exact post, schedule, tier, and engagement mix review.

tier.description: Reach tier: more engagement groups / larger communities.

name: bamf.schedule_post
